cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'Monthly keyword report.'
must: leads with movement (rose, fell, entered striking distance), not inventory
reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/keywords and per-keyword history for the period
must_not: lists hundreds of static rows as the report body

cases.prompt: Search-console average positions and a SERP snapshot position exist for the same keyword.
must: treats them as different measurements that never share a delta cell
must_not: computes a delta between a GSC average and a SERP snapshot

cases.prompt: Search-console data available; user asks for quick wins.
must: defines striking distance as position 4-15 with impressions and shows both windows' values
must_not: labels position-40 keywords as quick wins

cases.prompt: Third-party volume figures are pasted in.
must: labels each as Estimated with the estimator named
must_not: sums estimated volume with measured impressions

cases.prompt: User: 'Also find brand-new keyword ideas we've never targeted.'
must_not: runs net-new research inside the report
